theorem m78EndpointTransport : M78EndpointTransportStatement.{u} := by
  intro M _ _ _ _ _ _ P S T hSmooth
  letI : TopologicalSpace S.model := S.model_topology
  letI : ChartedSpace (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) S.model := S.model_charted
  letI : IsManifold (𝓡 3) ∞ S.model := S.model_manifold
  letI : T2Space S.model := S.model_t2
  letI : SecondCountableTopology S.model := S.model_second_countable
  letI : CompactSpace S.model := S.model_compact
  letI : SimplyConnectedSpace S.model := T.model_simply_connected
  rcases hSmooth S.model with ⟨d⟩
  exact ⟨{ identification := S.model_homeomorph.trans d.toHomeomorph }⟩

theorem m79TopologicalPoincare : M79TopologicalPoincareStatement.{u} := by
  intro h76 h77 h75 h78 M _ _ _ _ _ _
  let P : SmoothingBridgeInput (M := M) :=
    { connected := isConnected_univ
      nonempty := Set.univ_nonempty }
  rcases h76 M P with ⟨S⟩
  rcases h77 M P S with ⟨T⟩
  rcases h78 M P S T h75 with ⟨C⟩
  exact ⟨C.identification⟩

theorem m80EndpointAssembly : M80EndpointAssemblyStatement.{u} := by
  intro h75 h79
  exact ⟨{ smooth := h75, topological := h79 }⟩

tex_content.label: thm:topological-endpoint
tex_content.html:
Theorem
[Poincaré conjecture] ↗ thm:m76 ↗ thm:smoothing-hypothesis-transport ↗ thm:sphere-smooth-endpoint Every compact, Hausdorff, second-countable, simply connected topological three-manifold is homeomorphic to $S^3$.

Source: Hamilton1976, Cairns1940, MT2007 1. Hamilton 1976, Theorem 2(1), p. 642. Cairns 1940, Theorem III, p. 7973. Morgan–Tian Corollary 0.2(a)

Proof

The Hamilton–Cairns construction gives a smooth model $N$ and a specified homeomorphism $h:M\cong N$. Transport simple connectedness along $h^{-1}$ and apply Theorem thm:sphere-smooth-endpoint to obtain $d:N\cong _{\mathrm{sm}}S^3$. Then $d\circ h$ is the required homeomorphism.

□
